title: carlina acanthifolia nothosubsp. lecoqii
intro: Carlina acanthifolia nothosubsp. lecoqii, commonly known as Lecoq's carline thistle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a type of thistle that has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Carlina acanthifolia nothosubsp. lecoqii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor effects.
